sloka: सम्श्रुत्य शैब्यः श्येनाय स्वाम् तनुम् जगती पतिः ।प्रदाय पक्षिणो राजन् जगाम गतिम् उत्तमाम् ॥२-१४-४॥
transliteration: samśrutya śaibyaḥ śyenāya svām tanum jagatī patiḥ ।pradāya pakṣiṇo rājan jagāma gatim uttamām ॥2-14-4॥

translations.english: O King O lord of the earth (king) Saibya attained the highest state by offering his own body to a hawk in accordance with his promise.
